story: [R00] Raid 1 — Encounter 5 begins.

[R01] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Stood in the Fire
      "Bob is in the fire on purpose, briefly, for reasons Bob will explain later."

[R01] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Stood in the Fire
      "Dave does not retreat from things, and this is a thing."

[R01] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Dropped a Mechanic
      "Greg was going to call it out, then assumed somebody with a louder voice would."

[R01] Pip MISTAKE · Moderate · Dropped a Mechanic
      "Pip handed the job off to nobody in particular and walked away confident."

[R01] Kel MISTAKE · Moderate · Stood in the Fire
      "Kel stepped out, then stepped back for the one item on the floor."

[R01] Dave MISTAKE · Severe · Forgot to Taunt (after g01:r1:MIS_FIRE, depth 1)
      "Dave was checking whether the healers looked worried, which they now do."

[R01] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g05:r1:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Greg did the arithmetic, concluded the tank was underperforming, and generously stepped in."

[R01] Pip MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g06:r1:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Pip is being chased by something enormous and is telling everybody about it as it happens."

[R01] Kel MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after g07:r1:MIS_FIRE, depth 1)
      "Kel assumed someone else was handling it. Kel was the someone else."

[R01] Natsuna MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after g01:r1:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Natsuna is topping up the raider who is fine, because the one who is not fine is hard to look at."
[R01] Bob finally steps out of the fire.
[R01] Dave finally steps out of the fire.
[R01] Greg finally steps out of the fire.
[R01] Kel finally steps out of the fire.

[R01] Kel MISTAKE · Moderate · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g05:r1:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Kel brought up the seating plan for the guild dinner, mid-pull."
[R01] Kel drags Cindy into it.

[R01] Steve MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g05:r1:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Steve has said the thing everybody was thinking, and everybody is now thinking about that instead."
[R01] Steve drags Pip into it.

[R02] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Dropped a Mechanic
      "The boss did the thing the boss does, and Bob was still deciding."

[R02] Greg MISTAKE · Severe · Dropped a Mechanic (after g05:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Greg dropped it, picked it up, and dropped it again in front of everybody."
[R02] Main Boss turns on Pip.
[R02] Pip is DOWNED.
[R02] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R02] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g05:r1:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Greg would like it on record that the boss turned around of its own accord."

[R02] Steve MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g08:r1:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 2)
      "Steve was aiming at the adds, and the boss was standing in the adds, and here we are."

[R02] Zed MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank
      "Zed is now the most interesting person in the room and would very much like to stop being that."

[R02] Natsuna MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after g05:r2:MIS_AGGRO, depth 3)
      "Natsuna got there first, which counts for something, and healed the wrong person, which counts for less."

[R02] Fern MISTAKE · Moderate · Healed the Wrong Target (after g05:r2:MIS_AGGRO, depth 3)
      "Fern is saving the big heal for somebody who deserves it more, which is a philosophy, not a plan."
[R02] Bob finally steps out of the fire.
[R02] Pip is DEAD.

[R03] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Stood in the Fire (after g01:r1:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Dave moved out of the fire, checked, and moved back in to be sure."

[R03] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Dropped a Mechanic (after g05:r2:MIS_AGGRO, depth 3)
      "Greg put it down somewhere sensible, and sensible turned out to be where everybody was."

[R03] Kel MISTAKE · Severe · Stood in the Fire (after g07:r1:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Kel was mid-swing, and stopping mid-swing feels like giving up."
[R03] Zed is DOWNED.

[R03] Bob MISTAKE · Minor · Forgot to Taunt (after g00:r2:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Bob had one job this round and got absorbed in a different, more interesting job."

[R03] Greg MISTAKE · Severe · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g05:r2:MIS_AGGRO, depth 3)
      "The boss was busy with somebody else, which Greg read as an opportunity rather than as the plan working."

[R03] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Attacked the Wrong Target
      "Wanda is hitting the add that was going to die anyway, and is making very sure of it."

[R03] Cindy MISTAKE · Minor · Healed a Corpse (after g00:r3:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Cindy has not looked up and is still faithfully topping up the fallen."
[R03] Greg finally steps out of the fire.
[R03] Kel finally steps out of the fire.

[R03] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g00:r2:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Dave is arguing about a wipe from three weeks ago that Dave has clearly not let go of."
[R03] Dave drags Bob into it.

[R03] Fern MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g00:r3:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Fern stepped away for one moment, at the start of a fight that has moments in it."
[R03] Fern has wandered off for three rounds.

[R03] Zed MISTAKE · Severe · Started an Argument in Raid Chat (after g01:r3:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 2)
      "Zed said one word about the healing and the fight has become a meeting."
[R03] Zed drags Kel into it.
[R04] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.
[R04] Bob is DOWNED.
[R04] Greg is DOWNED.
[R04] Zed is DEAD.

[R04] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Stood in the Fire (after g01:r3:MIS_FIRE, depth 3)
      "Dave was following the person in front, who was also wrong."

[R04] Lyra MISTAKE · Severe · Dropped a Mechanic
      "Lyra did it beautifully, one round earlier than anybody needed it."
[R04] Steve is DEAD.

[R04] Cindy MISTAKE · Severe · Healed a Corpse (after g00:r3:MIS_TAUNT_LAPSE, depth 2)
      "Cindy is healing somebody who stopped needing it a round ago."
[R04] Dave finally steps out of the fire.
[R04] Lyra finally steps out of the fire.

[R04] Greg MISTAKE · Moderate · Went AFK (after g11:r4:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Greg is standing perfectly still with the calm of somebody who has gone to answer the door."
[R04] Greg has wandered off for two rounds.

[R05] Dave MISTAKE · Minor · Stood in the Fire (after g01:r3:MIS_ARGUMENT, depth 2)
      "The ground was glowing, and Dave decided that was decoration."
[R05] Dave is DEAD.
[R05] Bob taunts the boss back.

[R05] Fern MISTAKE · Severe · Went AFK (after g11:r4:MIS_MECHANIC_DROP, depth 1)
      "Fern has been away long enough that people have started dividing up Fern's job."
[R05] Fern has wandered off for three rounds.

[R06] Bob MISTAKE · Moderate · Dropped a Mechanic
      "Bob was counting, lost count, and rounded down."

[R06] Kel MISTAKE · Severe · Stood in the Fire
      "Kel assumed somebody would say something, and they were all busy."
[R06] Bob is DEAD.
[R06] Greg is DEAD.

[R06] Kel MISTAKE · Moderate · Attacked the Wrong Target (after g07:r6:MIS_FIRE, depth 1)
      "Kel spent the whole round on a target that had eleven other people on it."

[R06] Wanda MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g09:r3:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 1)
      "Wanda has one spell that is far better than the others and has now cast it four times running."

[R06] Natsuna MISTAKE · Minor · Healed a Corpse (after g09:r6:MIS_AGGRO, depth 2)
      "Natsuna refuses to accept the situation and is treating it as a temporary setback."
[R06] Kel finally steps out of the fire.

[R07] Lyra MISTAKE · Severe · Stood in the Fire
      "Lyra left the fire immediately, having stood in it for the whole round first."
[R07] Wanda is DEAD.

[R07] Kel MISTAKE · Moderate · Pulled Aggro Off the Tank (after g07:r6:MIS_WRONG_TARGET, depth 2)
      "Kel assumed the tank would take it back, and the tank assumed Kel had a plan."
[R07] Lyra finally steps out of the fire.
[R08] A raid-wide pulse hits everyone for 28.
[R08] Kel is DOWNED.
[R08] Lyra is DOWNED.
[R08] Natsuna is DOWNED.
[R08] Cindy is DOWNED.
[R08] Cindy is DEAD.
[R08] Natsuna is DEAD.
[R08] Kel is DEAD.
[R08] Lyra is DEAD.
[R09] Fern is DOWNED.
[R09] Fern is DEAD.
[R09] WIPE.
[R09] It traces back to Cindy — Healed a Corpse, round 4.
why: Worst case. Exercises soft wipe, cascades and the Critical cap.
